selected_script.angle: Stop trying to scrub burnt stovetop grease with a soapy sponge because it turns into an oily mess; foam the stuck-on grease first, then wipe it off cleanly
selected_script.hook: I was scrubbing this burner mess with dish soap, and it was just getting slimier.

script_record.voiceover: I was scrubbing this burner mess with dish soap, and it was just getting slimier. The grease kept sliding around the stovetop. So I grabbed EcoPure Lab, sprayed the foaming degreaser, let it sit for a second, then wiped. Way less scrubbing. If your stove gets like this, try this first.
script_record.visual_notes: Single continuous-feeling handheld phone video in a real American kitchen. Keep the product label visible when it enters: white trigger spray bottle, short rectangular white nozzle, ribbed white collar, orange label with dark navy lower band, EcoPure Lab logo, Heavy Duty Degreaser and Foaming Action identity, 10.1 fl oz / 300 ml cue if visible. Show only credible foam loosening grease, no exaggerated chemical smoke or magical effects.
script_record.claim_safety: Show removal of oily and burnt grease from stovetop surface only. Do not claim disinfecting, bacteria killing, medical safety, or guaranteed instant perfection.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create one complete approximately 10-second vertical 9:16 TikTok-style UGC ad in a realistic handheld phone-shot American kitchen, no UI, no subtitles, no stickers, no text overlays, no poster graphics. 0-3s: close-up of a greasy stainless stovetop burner area with brown burnt oil around the burner; a real hand uses a wet dish-soap sponge in circles, but the grease turns slippery and smears into gray-brown suds. Spoken hook: “I was scrubbing this burner mess with dish soap, and it was just getting slimier.” 3-5s: tighter handheld close-up shows the sponge lifting slightly, leaving oily streaks and messy residue still stuck near the burner edge; the person pauses with mild frustration, not exaggerated. 5-8.5s: the hand reaches to the counter and brings in the recognizable EcoPure Lab Heavy Duty Degreaser: white trigger spray bottle, short rectangular white nozzle, ribbed white screw collar, molded white plastic body with side finger grooves, glossy orange front label with dark navy bottom band, EcoPure Lab logo near the top, Heavy Duty Degreaser and Foaming Action identity, small stovetop image panel, 10.1 fl oz / 300 ml cue if visible. Keep the bottle design, colors, label placement, shape, and plastic material consistent with the reference image. Show the label briefly, then spray a modest white foam directly onto the greasy burner area; foam clings naturally and starts loosening the oily film. The person lets it sit for a beat, then wipes with a gray cloth in one clear pass. 8.5-10s: stable comparable close-up of the same stovetop spot looking much cleaner with the burner area visible and only a few natural reflections, product bottle standing nearby on the counter with label facing camera. Light spoken CTA: “Way less scrubbing. If your stove gets like this, try this first.” Realistic kitchen daylight, slight handheld movement, natural wiping sounds, credible before-after proof, no exaggerated chemical effects, no floating icons, no large advertising headlines, no changing the bottle to any other color or brand.
